title: Practice 3: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Тормоза заблокировались, и машину стало ___ (заносить / занести).
exercises.why: **занести́** — **заноси́ть** — to bring, to carry (in); to note down, to enter (data, records). **завести́** — **заводи́ть** — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy. **завезти́** — **завози́ть** — to take (to a place), to drop off (at a place); to supply, to deliver. **зале́зть** — **залеза́ть** — to climb up (finished action); (also figurative) to get into, to scramble. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The brakes locked, and the car began to skid.
exercises.context: занести́** — **заноси́ть — to bring, to carry (in); to note down, to enter (data, records).

exercises.prompt: Japan imports raw materials from China and exports finished products to it.
exercises.context: завезти́** — **завози́ть — to take (to a place), to drop off (at a place); to supply, to deliver.

exercises.q: За дальнейшей информацией ___ (заходить / зайти), пожалуйста, на наш вебсайт.
exercises.why: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я так крупно налажал, что найти бы вот какую-нибудь нору да ___ (заползти / заползать) туда.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В чепыгу ___ (залезть / залезать — to climb up).
exercises.why: (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Беспокойный гость».
exercises.context: (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю.

exercises.q: Откуда кожан ___ (залететь / залетать — to fly)?.
exercises.why: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.. **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Алексей К. Толстой, «Князь Серебряный».
exercises.context: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst..
